speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: For the benefit of new Members, under the Standing Orders, the debate on the Address of Thanks ordinarily takes precedence over Ministerial Statements and business Motions should be disposed of before the debate on the Address of Thanks takes place.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: I am moving this business Motion for two reasons.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: Members will have sufficient time to seek clarification on these Ministerial Statements.
